# Image4me - Free Online WebP & Image Converter

> Image4me is a high-speed, 100% private, browser-side web application designed for converting PNG to WebP, JPG to WebP, JPEG to WebP, WebP to PNG, and WebP to JPG without uploading files to external servers.

## Core Purpose & Value Proposition
Image4me helps web developers, digital marketers, content creators, and site owners optimize web images for faster page loading speeds, improved Google Core Web Vitals (Largest Contentful Paint - LCP), and reduced bandwidth consumption.

## Key Features & Converter Specs
- **PNG to WebP Conversion**: Converts 32-bit transparent or 24-bit RGB PNG files to WebP. Preserves alpha channel transparency while reducing file sizes by 26% to 80%.
- **JPG / JPEG to WebP Conversion**: Optimizes photographic images into WebP format with custom quality sliders (0% to 100%).
- **WebP to PNG / JPG Conversion**: Converts WebP images back into standard PNG or JPEG formats for compatibility with legacy graphic editors.
- **Bulk Batch Processing**: Concurrently converts up to 100 images per batch.
- **Client-Side Privacy Guarantee**: All image rendering and compression takes place strictly inside the user's browser using HTML5 Canvas and WebAssembly. No files are uploaded to any server.
- **One-Click Download & ZIP Archive**: Download files individually or package entire batches into a single ZIP file via JSZip.

## Supported Conversion Pairs
- PNG to WebP (`png-to-webp`)
- JPG / JPEG to WebP (`jpg-to-webp`)
- WebP to PNG (`webp-to-png`)
- WebP to JPG (`webp-to-jpg`)
- GIF to WebP (`gif-to-webp`)
